title: The Dark Truth About The Witches (1990 film) #Shorts
description:
Nothing in The Witches (1990 film) was built for you — it was built for reproduction. The Witches is a 1990 dark fantasy film directed by Nicolas Roeg from a screenplay by Allan Scott and based on Roald Dahl's novel of the same name. The film stars Anjelica Huston and Mai Zetterling and concerns evil witches who masquerade as ordinary women and follows an orphaned boy and his grandmother, who must find a way to foil their plot of ridding the world of children.

The psychology underneath The Witches (1990 film) is simpler and older than the story on top. Both versions (and any television screenings) use the original open matte negative of the film, instead of matting it down to 1.85:1 (or 1.66:1). In July 2019, a Blu-ray release from Warner Archive Collection was announced, and was released on August 20, 2019.
